More missiles, faster reacquisition, and broad target coverage. / Fewer compromises: heavier impacts, boss damage, and explosive payloads.
More shells and better coverage against large formations. / Bigger blasts, lingering shrapnel, and stronger payload interception.
Longer, stronger slowing and broader control of the whole screen. / EMP remains non-damaging but makes enemies easier to destroy.
Multiple pulses, wider coverage, and repeated lane clearing. / One enormous shot optimized for bosses and armored targets.
Crushes targets together and increases damage inside the well. / Larger wells, longer duration, and multiple placement options.
Improves combat performance and prioritizes dangerous payloads. / Improves salvage collection, repairs, and defensive utility.
Adds more projectiles and wider coverage. / Keeps a tighter volley but adds impact effects and penetration.
Improves tracking, reacquisition, and multi-target performance. / Trades some broad tracking for penetration and priority-target damage.
Suggested implementation: recover the relic at Level 1, then spend carapaces between waves. A branch-selection rule can be added later without changing the workbook structure.
